verdict.rationale: Runpod has a dedicated security-and-compliance doc stating Secure Cloud partners meet SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS, and clarifies datacenter tiers (T3/T4 for Secure Cloud vs peer-to-peer Community Cloud), giving platform engineers concrete compliance signals. However, this is limited to first-party docs with no independent audit report, trust-center link, or third-party attestation, and Community Cloud (peer-to-peer) explicitly lacks these guarantees, creating a bifurcated posture a buyer must navigate carefully. Missing for 10: independent SOC 2 report/certificate access or auditor attestation, detailed data-handling/retention policy, and clarity on which specific data centers/providers hold which certifications.
